# Legacy budget PDFs (reference for the PDF visual diff)

"Proposta comercial" PDFs for **11 real budgets** from the anonymized production fixture
(`../prod-2026-11-11.anon.dibbak`), generated by the **unchanged legacy code** (`GET /api/budget/getPdf/:id` →
`helpers/budgetPdfGenerator.js` → pdfmake 0.1.37, Roboto from `pdfmake/vfs_fonts.js`). They are the acceptance
reference for the new app's PDFsharp generator (PLAN.md §7.1 "PDF", Phase 3 exit: visual diff within tolerance).
Names and texts are anonymized (scrambled, same length and character classes); numbers, dates and layout-relevant
shapes are real.

## Re-generating

```sh
tools/legacy/legacy.sh pdf-samples   # starts the legacy mongo:4.1.4 if needed; about 30 s
```

`tools/legacy/pdf-samples.js` restores the fixture with the legacy restore code into a throwaway database
`dib4t_pdf_samples` (dropped at the end; `dib4t` is never touched), mounts the unchanged `routes/budget.js` in
process and downloads each PDF through HTTP, decoding the base64 body like the legacy UI. **Deterministic**: two
runs give byte-identical files (2026-11-14). Fixed for that:

| What | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `TZ` | `UTC` | The legacy production container (`back-end/dockerfile`, `node:14-alpine`) sets no time zone, so "Data do Documento" is the **UTC** date of `budget.date`. The new app prints the Europe/Lisbon date instead (D23). |
| Clock | `2026-11-14T10:00:00Z` | pdfkit writes `CreationDate = new Date()` into the document info. |
| `Math.random` | seeded per PDF | pdfkit names font subsets `<6 random A–Z>+Roboto-…`. Random in legacy too: **not** part of the contract. |

The budgets are picked by rules (`PICKS` in the script), so the same fixture always gives the same samples.

**Cross-check with the running legacy app (2026-11-14):** the fixture restored into the local legacy app
(`legacy.sh up` + `restore`) and the same 11 budgets downloaded from `:3001`. Ignoring `CreationDate` and the
subset tags, 10 files are byte-identical; `09` differs only in the date (`25/5/2022` with the host in
Europe/Lisbon vs `24/5/2022` in UTC), which is exactly what that sample is for.

## Files

`manifest.json` lists per sample: the rule (`why`), `budgetId`, the HTTP response (status, `Content-Type:
application/pdf`, `Content-Disposition: attachment;filename="filename.pdf"`, base64 length), the **printed inputs**
(the values `budgetPdfGenerator.js` uses, incl. the computed document date) and PDF facts (bytes, sha256, PDF 1.3,
pages, A4 MediaBox `[0 0 595.28 841.89]`, embedded fonts, 1 image = the logo).

| File | Budget | Pages | What it tests |
|---|---|---|---|
| `01-typical.pdf` | 22-0691 R0 | 1 | Baseline: rev 0, 60 days → "9 semanas", Int32 total, median-length description |
| `02-revision.pdf` | 25-0573 R4 | 2 | "Nº 25-0573 \| R 4"; long payment condition wraps and **overlaps** the VAT line (footer is absolutely positioned) |
| `03-days-le-7.pdf` | 22-0319 R0 | 1 | 7 days → "7 dias" (the `> 7` boundary), validity 15 |
| `04-longest-description.pdf` | 25-0246 R0 | 2 | Longest description (3,724 chars): text flows onto page 2, footer moves to page 2 |
| `05-most-lines.pdf` | 26-0470 R0 | 3 | 93 lines: text runs to page 3 but the **footer stays on page 2**; blank lines; `₂ ₃` are missing from the font (drawn as empty boxes) |
| `06-no-description.pdf` | 22-0217 R0 | 1 | Description field missing: empty block, only Roboto-Medium embedded; client fields "-" |
| `07-double-total.pdf` | 24-0084 R0 | 1 | Double total `4143.75` → "4143.75 €" (JS number to string: no thousands separator, `.` decimal, no fixed decimals) |
| `08-client-missing-fields.pdf` | 24-0434 R0 | 1 | Client address, location, zip code all `""`: blank lines keep their fixed positions |
| `09-utc-date-differs.pdf` | 22-0377 R0 | 1 | `date` 2022-05-24T23:00:37Z = 25 May in Lisbon; PDF shows **24/5/2022** (UTC). 37 of 3,397 real budgets are affected (D23) |
| `10-longest-texts.pdf` | 26-0286 R0 | 2 | Longest client name wraps and **overlaps** the address line; total 222000 |
| `11-special-chars.pdf` | 22-0617 R0 | 2 | Tabs (drawn as a wide gap), `•`, Word Symbol bullet U+F0A7 (missing glyph → empty box) |

## Layout facts of the legacy PDFs (found with these samples)

Two of them are **changed on purpose** in the new app (owner decisions 2026-11-14, `docs/decisions/0005-legacy-defects.md`):
**D22** long texts grow downward instead of overlapping (samples `02`, `10` get new approved expected images) and
**D23** the document date is the Europe/Lisbon date (sample `09` expects `25/5/2022`). Everything else is reproduced.


- Every element is **absolutely positioned**; nothing reflows. Long texts wrap at the page's right margin and
  overlap the next fixed line (02, 10). New app: blocks grow downward (D22).
- The description starts at (30,355) + margins and **flows across pages**. The footer block (dotted line at y=710 +
  4 lines + Total) goes onto the **second page** whenever the description needs more than one page
  (`pageBreakBefore` on the `anchor` node), even if the description continues on page 3 (05).
- Revision 0 prints `Nº 22-0691 ` (trailing space); revision n prints `Nº 25-0573 | R 4`.
- Document date: `d/M/yyyy` of `budget.date` in **UTC**. New app: Europe/Lisbon (D23).
- Total: JavaScript `Number#toString()` (`4143.75`, `222000`) + `" €"`. In .NET use
  `double.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)` / Int32 `ToString(InvariantCulture)`.
- Characters missing from pdfmake's Roboto (`₂`, `₃`, U+F0A7) are drawn as the `.notdef` glyph; tabs are not expanded
  to tab stops. Real data: 586 tabs, 4 × U+F0A7, 1 × `₂`/`₃`, 6 × U+200B, 3 × combining U+0303 in descriptions.
- Info: `Producer`/`Creator` = `pdfmake`, PDF 1.3. Fonts: `Roboto-Regular` (description) and `Roboto-Medium`
  (bold), subset-embedded.

## Comparing in Phase 3

Render both PDFs with the **same** renderer at the same DPI and pixel-compare per page (page counts must match).
Samples `02`, `10` (D22) and `09` (D23) are compared against approved new-app images, not against these files.
`CreationDate`, font subset tags and object order are not compared. A quick visual check on macOS:
`sips -s format png 01-typical.pdf --out /tmp/01.png` (page 1 only).
